     PRIMARY_KEY = ["username", "work_id", "edition_id"]

+    @classmethod
+    def update_work_id(cls, current_work_id, new_work_id, _test=False):
+        """Update booknotes to a new work ID without losing conflicting notes.
+
+        If any row would violate the booknotes primary key, roll back the whole
+        update so every original record remains intact.
+        """
+        oldb = db.get_db()
+        transaction = oldb.transaction()
+        try:
+            rows_changed = oldb.update(
+                cls.TABLENAME,
+                where="work_id=$work_id",
+                work_id=new_work_id,
+                vars={"work_id": current_work_id},
+            )
+        except (UniqueViolation, IntegrityError):
+            transaction.rollback()
+            return {
+                "rows_changed": 0,
+                "rows_deleted": 0,
+                "failed_deletes": 1,
+            }
+
+        transaction.rollback() if _test else transaction.commit()
+        return {
+            "rows_changed": rows_changed,
+            "rows_deleted": 0,
+            "failed_deletes": 0,
+        }
+
